title: CakeHats
description: This rescourcepack is for people that have a curse of binding carved pumpkin on their hardcore world, this cheers them up a bit.😇
body:
# **NO** OPTIFINE REQUIRED!
## The pack
This pack uses custom block models to make a carved pumpkin look like a custom modelled cake.
## Installation
This pack doesn't require any dependencies (except the game of course), just put it in your pack folder and enjoy your cake!
## Plans
I'm planning to add custom names or changing the model depending on the name of the carved pumpkin that's set in an anvil.
## Licensing
Feel free to use any of this pack - i don't need credit. It basically has no license.


_Yee, that was it. Enjoy your cute little cake hat!_
